label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones _____? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
verse: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
note: The valley of dry bones — Ezekiel wisely leaves the answer to God.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let us draw _____ with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verse: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
note: An open invitation: draw near with a true heart — the way into God's presence is open now.

label: Sunday School
prompt: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the _____ that remain, that nothing be lost.
verse: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
note: After feeding five thousand, Jesus still said not to waste the fragments — twelve baskets of leftovers.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Whosoever _____, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
verse: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
note: The elder warns: whoever wanders off from Christ's teaching has wandered away from God himself.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with _____, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
verse: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
note: Moses warns of curses 'because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness' — grudging service amid abundance.
